Title: Production extension architecture
Description: Define the modular production architecture for Fabric consortium, payments, IoT/EPCIS, documents, Shariah certification, export signing, ERP/accounting, and UI productization.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given the plan is reviewed, when implementation begins, then every production extension area has modular boundaries, PBIs, dependencies, and source references.
Notes: Deployment relevance: production-extension. Source: docs/architecture/EXTENDED_PRODUCTION_ARCHITECTURE_PLAN.tex.

Title: Production Fabric consortium plan
Description: Define production Fabric CA, MSP, peer, orderer, channel, private data, endorsement, chaincode lifecycle, and governance operating model.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given the plan is complete, when reviewed by blockchain engineer, then org mapping, MSP policy, channel design, private data boundaries, and operational runbooks are clear.
Notes: Deployment relevance: production-extension. Source: docs/architecture/FABRIC_MVP_BOUNDARY.md; Hyperledger Fabric docs.

Title: Production Fabric consortium implementation
Description: Implement the production-ready Fabric network skeleton and adapter configuration while retaining local/sandbox proof mode.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given Fabric mode is configured, when the app starts, then it can connect to the configured Fabric gateway or fail safely to unavailable proof state.
Notes: Deployment relevance: production-extension. No raw business documents on-chain.

Title: Payment adapter framework
Description: Add a payment orchestration port with LocalSandboxPaymentAdapter, ManualSettlementAdapter, and future external payment adapter seams.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given escrow release creates a payment instruction, when sandbox mode is active, then no real money moves and payment state is recorded auditable.
Notes: Deployment relevance: pilot-hardening. Swappable payment integration required.

Title: ISO 20022 payment execution mapping
Description: Map platform payment instructions and settlement statuses to ISO 20022-like payment initiation and status artifacts.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a payment instruction exists, when export is requested, then required debtor, creditor, amount, currency, remittance, and status fields are populated.
Notes: Deployment relevance: production-extension. First adapter may be sandbox/file-based.

Title: Escrow release workflow
Description: Extend escrow from creation-only to release-condition evaluation, release instruction, hold, expiry, refund, and audit proof.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given delivery and acceptance conditions are satisfied, when buyer triggers release, then escrow moves to release-approved and payment instruction is created.
Notes: Deployment relevance: pilot-hardening. No automatic settlement until payment adapter confirms status.

Title: Dispute and arbitration workflow
Description: Add dispute case, evidence exchange, hold, arbitration decision, release/refund outcome, and audit trail.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a party raises a dispute, when arbitration decision is recorded, then escrow outcome is release, refund, or cancellation with immutable evidence.
Notes: Deployment relevance: production-extension. External arbitration integration remains post-MVP.

Title: IoT and QR evidence API
Description: Expose external IoT and QR proof ingestion APIs with device credentials, replay protection, signature validation, and safe metadata storage.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a valid signed device event is posted, when validation succeeds, then a delivery evidence record and lifecycle event are created.
Notes: Deployment relevance: pilot-hardening. Raw device payloads must be controlled and hashed.

Title: EPCIS logistics adapter
Description: Add EPCIS-compatible event import/export mapping for shipment, receipt, inspection, and custody events.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given an EPCIS-compatible payload is submitted, when validation passes, then the platform maps it to delivery evidence and lifecycle metadata.
Notes: Deployment relevance: production-extension. Source: GS1 EPCIS 2.0.

Title: Document storage and rendering
Description: Add secure document upload, object storage, malware scan, MIME validation, preview metadata, and access policy.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given an authorized user uploads a document, when validation passes, then metadata, hash, storage reference, and access policy are stored without on-chain raw content.
Notes: Deployment relevance: pilot-hardening. Object storage can start local/S3-compatible.

Title: Document signature verification
Description: Verify digital signatures on uploaded contracts, delivery proofs, and export bundles and record certificate chain metadata.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a signed PDF or detached signature is submitted, when verification runs, then signature status and certificate metadata are recorded.
Notes: Deployment relevance: production-extension. No formal trust store until policy approved.

Title: Formal Shariah certification artifacts
Description: Add Shariah certificate records for PLS templates, version scope, conditions, expiry, revocation, and certificate hash.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a certificate covers a PLS template, when activation is requested, then the platform verifies certificate scope and status before activation.
Notes: Deployment relevance: pilot-hardening. Formal external certification remains outside system automation.

Title: Export signing and key management
Description: Add signed export manifests, key profiles, rotation policy, detached signatures, and offline verification package.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given an export bundle is generated, when signing is enabled, then detached signature and verification instructions are included.
Notes: Deployment relevance: pilot-hardening. Production KMS/HSM decision required.

Title: ERP and accounting adapter framework
Description: Add adapter framework for importing/exporting orders, invoices, receipts, payments, and journal events using UBL/OCDS mappings.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given an adapter profile is configured, when sync runs, then inbound/outbound records are mapped with idempotency and error reporting.
Notes: Deployment relevance: production-extension. Source: UBL, OCDS, Peppol.

Title: Contract negotiation workspace
Description: Add negotiation threads, redlines, approval routing, offer/acceptance records, and linked machine-readable terms.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given buyer and supplier negotiate terms, when an agreement is reached, then final terms are versioned and linked to order/escrow.
Notes: Deployment relevance: pilot-hardening. Communication records must be auditable.

Title: Machine-readable contract model
Description: Add a semantic contract model for parties, clauses, obligations, release conditions, PLS terms, attachments, and hashes.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a contract is created, when saved, then clause IDs, human text, machine-readable fields, version, and hash are stored.
Notes: Deployment relevance: pilot-hardening. Maps to UBL/OCDS where appropriate.

Title: Blockchain status visualization
Description: Add operator and actor-facing blockchain status visualizations across order, delivery, escrow, export, PLS, and Fabric network health.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given proof records exist, when user opens status surface, then visual indicators show anchored, pending, failed, mismatch, unavailable, and verified states.
Notes: Deployment relevance: pilot-hardening. No fabricated chain data. Status review 2026-05-26: visual proof/status indicator foundation added, but full Fabric network health and PLS-wide coverage remain open.

Title: Responsive panel shell and icon-only navigation
Description: Implement resizable panels, icon-only collapse, compact cards, and persisted panel preferences.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given the viewport or panel is reduced, when UI reflows, then panels remain usable with icons, truncation, and overflow-safe content.
Notes: Deployment relevance: pilot-hardening. Inspired by Docker-style compact navigation. Completed 2026-05-26: responsive shell includes resizable navigation panel, persisted width, and icon-only collapse.

Title: Theme and design tokens
Description: Implement dark/white/yellow design tokens and indicator colors for verified, pending, failed, warning, and info states.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given theme tokens are applied, when surfaces render, then colors are consistent and indicators are visual, not word-only.
Notes: Deployment relevance: productization. Completed 2026-05-26: centralized theme tokens and status indicator colors added.

Title: CSS modularization and overflow hardening
Description: Separate CSS into tokens, layout, components, and page files; fix text overflow and resizing behavior.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a component is resized, when IDs/hashes/status cards are displayed, then text wraps or truncates without escaping containers.
Notes: Deployment relevance: productization. Inline styles only for dynamic CSS variables. Completed 2026-05-26: CSS aggregator/modules added and long hash/ID overflow hardening applied.

Title: Database-seeded real demo accounts
Description: Move demo accounts and case data into database seed records and remove dependence on local-only in-browser identity data where backend mode is active.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given db:seed runs, when app starts in backend mode, then demo actors authenticate through seeded credentials and records.
Notes: Deployment relevance: pilot-hardening. Real demo accounts, not demonstrative frontend-only accounts. Completed 2026-05-26: db seed verified for nine backend demo accounts using demo-password.

Title: Remove demonstrative local fallbacks
Description: Identify and remove or gate demonstrative local-only features where seeded backend data and APIs now exist.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given backend mode is active, when UI calls a workflow, then it uses backend APIs and does not silently use local fabricated data.
Notes: Deployment relevance: pilot-hardening. Local demo fallback allowed only when explicitly configured. Completed 2026-05-26: frontend local fallbacks gated by explicit VITE_ENABLE_LOCAL_DEMO_FALLBACK flag; guided mode gated separately.

Title: External API gateway for integrations
Description: Add authenticated external API gateway for IoT devices, ERP applications, payment callbacks, and evidence verifiers.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given an external client calls an API, when credentials and signature pass, then request is processed with scoped permissions and audit logging.
Notes: Deployment relevance: pilot-hardening. Requires rate limiting and idempotency. Completed 2026-05-26: signed external proof verification route plus scoped client credentials plus idempotency plus external audit repository plus contract added; evidence: docs/evidence/qa/PBI-458_EXTERNAL_API_GATEWAY_VALIDATION.md.

Title: Containerized deployable model
Description: Add backend and frontend Dockerfiles and full Docker Compose app stack with postgres, backend, frontend, and optional integration profiles.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a clean operator runs docker compose up --build, when env is configured, then frontend, backend, and postgres start with health checks.
Notes: Deployment relevance: deployable internal pilot. Completed 2026-05-26: deployable Dockerfiles plus app compose plus health/readiness checks plus runbook plus smoke script added; live image build blocked by Docker Hub connectivity in this environment; evidence: docs/evidence/qa/PBI-459_CONTAINERIZED_DEPLOYABLE_MODEL_VALIDATION.md.

Title: Observability and incident hooks
Description: Add health/readiness, structured logs, metrics, alerts, and operator incident hooks.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a service degrades, when health checks or thresholds fail, then an alert is recorded and visible to operators.
Notes: Deployment relevance: pilot-hardening. Completed 2026-05-26: protected ops status route plus readiness-derived incidents plus security alert integration plus structured logging runbook added; evidence: docs/evidence/qa/PBI-460_OBSERVABILITY_INCIDENT_HOOKS_VALIDATION.md.

Title: Backup restore rollback runbook
Description: Add backup, restore, rollback, reset, and disaster recovery runbook for database, documents, and Fabric proof data.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given operator follows runbook, when backup/restore commands run, then data can be recovered or reset safely.
Notes: Deployment relevance: deployable internal pilot. Completed 2026-05-26: backup restore rollback runbook plus dry-run-safe PostgreSQL backup restore and local rollback scripts added; evidence: docs/evidence/qa/PBI-461_BACKUP_RESTORE_ROLLBACK_VALIDATION.md.

Title: Procurement and public contract standards mapping research
Description: Research public procurement activity, OCDS, UBL, Peppol, and formal contract structures and map them to platform fields.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given the research spike closes, when architects review it, then machine-readable contract and ERP/export mappings have justified field sets and references.
Notes: Deployment relevance: product-market hardening.
